title: Shopify Theme Store requirements (checklist)
note: Paraphrased checklist. Re-check the source before every submission; requirements change.

requirements.rule: Built from Skeleton theme or original code. Dawn/Horizon-derived themes are ineligible.
Fundamentally different from every Theme Store theme, incl. own themes. Color/font/spacing/animation swaps do not count.
Preset names 1-2 words, <30 chars, unique, not an industry/collection word (e.g. not 'Fashion'), not a brand or SEO term. One preset carries the parent theme name.
Multi-preset themes: each preset has its own templates in /listings/<preset>/ (optional sections subfolder).
Each preset has a demo store matching its industry and catalog size; install state matches demo layout, colors, typography.
Required: theme.liquid, 404, article, blog, cart, collection, index, list-collections, page, page.contact, password, product, search (JSON), gift_card.liquid, settings_data, settings_schema.
All templates support sections (except customer accounts, gift card, checkout).
Custom Liquid section on all section templates; Custom Liquid blocks where app blocks fit.
Header and footer render in section groups.
Main product: price, vendor, description etc. each their own block; @app blocks in main + featured product.
Item and order discounts shown in cart.
Accelerated checkout on product and cart, enabled by default, branded colors untouched.
Faceted filtering by availability, price, type, vendor, variant options on collection + search.
Gift card template (QR >=120px, Apple Wallet) and recipient fields on gift card products.
Image focal points supported.
Country/language selectors when multi-currency/language.
Nested menus.
Newsletter signup.
Pickup availability on product page.
Related and complementary products.
3D models + YouTube/Vimeo in product, featured product and quick view.
Search template (mixed results, no-results, pagination) + predictive search.
Selling plans shown in cart.
Shop Pay Installments banner on product page.
Unit price on collection, product, cart.
Variant image shown when variant selected; swatches supported.
Follow on Shop via login_button filter.
<shopify-account> component in desktop and mobile header.
No app-like features: wishlist, booking, cart discount code field, Instagram feed.
No fake urgency/scarcity, countdowns, fake stock levels or viewer counts.
Lighthouse performance avg >= 60 (home, collection, product; desktop + mobile).
Lighthouse accessibility avg >= 90; keyboard nav, visible focus, alt text, labels, 4.5:1 / 3:1 contrast, 24px targets, distinct headings.
Latest Safari/Chrome/Firefox/Edge, mobile Safari/Chrome/Samsung, Instagram/Facebook/Pinterest webviews.
Native CSS (no Sass), own code not minified, scripts on Shopify CDN, routes object, protocol-relative assets.
SEO meta + canonical, product rich snippets, Open Graph/Twitter, no robots.txt.liquid.
Favicon, any-ratio logo, theme_info; every setting labeled; font_picker with real fonts; >=4 colors with bg/fg pairs.
Sentence case, American English, no ampersands, buttons start with a verb, Shopify terminology.
Real content (no lorem ipsum), test payments only, no apps, licensed assets.
Docs + support form; respond within 2 business days; exclusive to Theme Store.
